# Ahrefs

Ahrefs is an SEO and marketing platform offering site audits, keyword research, content analysis, and competitive insights to improve search rankings and drive organic traffic

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/ahrefs/.

## Actions

- **Backlinks stats retrieval** (read-only): Retrieves comprehensive backlink statistics for a specified website or url using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Fetch all backlinks** (read-only): Retrieves a comprehensive list of backlinks for a specified website or url using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Fetch competitors overview** (read-only): Retrieves a comprehensive overview of competitor data in relation to keyword rankings and organic search performance.
- **Fetch rank tracker overview** (read-only): The getranktrackeroverview endpoint retrieves a comprehensive summary of keyword rankings and seo performance data from ahrefs' rank…
- **Get serp overview** (read-only): Retrieves a comprehensive overview of search engine results pages (serp) data for specified keywords or queries.
- **Retrieve anchor data** (read-only): Retrieves anchor text data for a specified website or url using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Retrieve crawler ip ranges** (read-only): Retrieves the list of ip address ranges used by ahrefs' web crawler (ahrefsbot).
- **Retrieve outlinks stats** (read-only): Retrieves comprehensive statistics about outgoing links (outlinks) from a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Retrieve site explorer keywords history** (read-only): Retrieves historical keyword performance data for a specified website or domain using ahrefs' site explorer.
- **Search suggestions explorer** (read-only): Retrieves search suggestions for a given keyword or phrase using ahrefs' keywords explorer tool.
- **Batch Url Analysis** (read-only): Performs a batch analysis on multiple urls or domains using ahrefs' powerful seo metrics.
- **Domain rating for site explorer** (read-only): Retrieves the domain rating (dr) for a specified domain.
- **Domain rating history** (read-only): Retrieves the historical domain rating (dr) data for a specified domain over time.
- **Explore keyword volume by country** (read-only): Retrieves the search volume data for specified keywords across different countries using ahrefs' keywords explorer tool.
- **Explore keywords overview** (read-only): Retrieves a comprehensive overview of keyword data from ahrefs' keywords explorer tool.
- **Explore linked domains of a site** (read-only): Retrieves a list of external domains that the specified target website or url links to, using ahrefs' site explorer functionality.
- **Explore matching terms for keywords** (read-only): The keywords explorer matching terms endpoint retrieves a list of keyword phrases that match or contain the specified keyword from ahrefs'…
- **Fetch broken backlinks data** (read-only): Retrieves a list of broken backlinks for a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Fetch site explorer referring domains** (read-only): Retrieves a list of domains that have backlinks pointing to a specified target website.
- **Fetch total search volume history** (read-only): Retrieves the historical total search volume data for specified keywords using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Get site audit projects** (read-only): Retrieves a list of site audit projects associated with the authenticated ahrefs account.
- **Get site explorer country metrics** (read-only): Retrieves country-specific site explorer metrics for a given website from ahrefs.
- **Get site explorer linked anchors external** (read-only): The site-explorer-linked-anchors-external endpoint retrieves data about external anchor texts linking to a specified target website.
- **Get url rating history** (read-only): Retrieves the historical url rating data for a specified url over time.
- **Linked anchors explorer** (read-only): Retrieves information about internal linked anchors for a specified website using the ahrefs api.
- **List best by external links** (read-only): The 'get best by external links' endpoint retrieves a list of pages from a specified website, ranked by the number of external links…
- **Pages by traffic overview** (read-only): Retrieves a list of pages from a specified website, ordered by their estimated organic search traffic.
- **Retrieve best by internal links** (read-only): Retrieves data on the best-performing internal links within a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer feature.
- **Retrieve organic competitors** (read-only): The getorganiccompetitors endpoint in the ahrefs api provides a comprehensive analysis of websites competing for organic search rankings…
- **Retrieve organic keywords** (read-only): Retrieves organic keywords data for a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Retrieve paid pages data** (read-only): Retrieves information about paid pages (ppc advertising) for a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Retrieve public crawler ips** (read-only): Retrieves a list of ip addresses currently used by ahrefsbot, ahrefs' web crawler.
- **Retrieve related terms** (read-only): The keywords explorer related terms endpoint retrieves a list of related terms for a given keyword using ahrefs' extensive keyword database.
- **Retrieve site explorer metrics** (read-only): The getsiteexplorermetrics endpoint retrieves comprehensive seo metrics for a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Retrieve site explorer metrics history** (read-only): Retrieves historical seo metrics data for a specified website over a given time period.
- **Retrieve site explorer pages history** (read-only): The get site explorer pages history endpoint retrieves historical data about specific pages or domains from ahrefs' site explorer.
- **Retrieve site explorer referring domains history** (read-only): Retrieves the historical data of referring domains for a specified website or url over time.
- **Retrieve subscription limits and usage** (read-only): Retrieves detailed information about the current subscription limits and usage for an ahrefs account.
- **Retrieve top pages from site explorer** (read-only): Retrieves data about the top-performing pages of a specified website using ahrefs' site explorer tool.
- **Retrieve volume history** (read-only): Retrieves the historical search volume data for a specified keyword using ahrefs' keywords explorer tool.
